summary: Built web UI components for three extensions in the gizmo registry. For search-and-scrape, wrote SearchToolResult.svelte and ScrapeToolResult.svelte cards. For subagents, created a state bridge (state.ts) between Pi and agent-server, plus the runtime, panel, tool result card, and index/export files. For workflows, created the server index reading run artifacts, plus types, runtime, panel, and tool result card.
decisions: Search and scrape cards reuse app-level data-ui generic styles (tool-parameters, tool-metrics, tool-empty, etc.) plus scoped <style> blocks for extension-specific bits
Subagent state bridge writes a bounded snapshot per session under `<agentDir>/subagents/state/` since SubagentManager only exists in Pi; agent-server reads the JSON files
State writes are debounced (~250ms) and the file is deleted on session_shutdown
Workflows server half reads artifacts (workflow.json, transcripts.json, result.json) under `<agentDir>/workflows/<runId>/` rather than importing the live RunController, keeping it Pi-runtime-free
runId validation uses a safe character set to prevent path traversal when reading workflow artifacts
errors: Edit to subagents/src/state.ts failed because oldText used tabs but the written file used 2-space indentation; resolved by rewriting the whole file with tabs
